# graylog_index_set_strategy_types (Data Source)

Lists available Graylog index set rotation and retention strategies, including `json_schema` properties as `requested_configuration` and `default_config`. Use this when configuring `graylog_index_set.rotation_strategy` / `retention_strategy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_index_set_strategy_types" "available" {}

output "rotation_strategies" {
  value = {
    for s in data.graylog_index_set_strategy_types.available.rotation :
    s.type => [for f in s.requested_configuration : f.name]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `retention` (Attributes List) Available retention strategies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention))
- `rotation` (Attributes List) Available rotation strategies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rotation))
